{{Quote|Sounds like a dew run|Gavin Darklighter to Wedge Antilles about a mission|<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
"'''Dew run'''" was a slang term used to describe a simple and easy mission. The term most likely originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as a reference to the [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]].<ref name="KT" />
